lastText: The Night EndsA House of Many RoomsNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 15A COUNT FROM THE EAST TAKES A HOUSE IN ANTWERPThe steamer for Antwerp leaves on the ebb with eight passengers, four names and a great deal of baggage. The hunters reach the quay a quarter of an hour late. By the time they think to search the ships, you are in the Scheldt, under a name they do not know. In Antwerp there is a good house with a chapel. It has a long table, which you set every night for people who do not eat, and a hall, in which a servant stands at attention at every door. It is a court. It is a small and quiet one. People cannot agree what he was. A policeman says a foreign gentleman and a housemaid says a great lord. A doctor writes a long paper on mass delusion, and a priest writes a short letter on something else.
